visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a graphic-based title card overlaying several Meiji brand snack boxes including Macadamia, Galbo, and Cacao Effect. Large red and white text dominates the center. (2) A person's hands are shown using a metal knife to cut open a green macadamia chocolate on a white surface, revealing the nut inside. (3) A woman with her hair tied back in a bun, wearing a black top, opens a box of macadamia chocolates and begins cutting them on a wooden board. (4) The woman places a slice of white bread into a red electric sandwich press, adds the chopped chocolates, and sprinkles shredded white cheese on top before closing the lid. (5) The finished hot-pressed sandwich is pulled apart by the woman's hands, showing long strings of melted white cheese and chocolate. (6) A new section begins with the woman holding three different boxes of 'Cacao Effect' chocolates (72%, 86%, 95%). (7) She drops a piece of dark chocolate into a white bowl containing brown curry sauce and places it into a white microwave. (8) After heating, she stirs the melted chocolate into the curry with a spoon, comparing two different concentrations. (9) The woman holds a bowl of curry rice with fried chicken, takes a bite, and smiles. (10) Various bags of 'Galbo' snacks are displayed. The woman puts several pieces into a plastic wrap and crushes them with her hands and a wooden spoon. (11) She sprinkles the crushed chocolate bits onto a bowl of white yogurt and tastes it with a spoon. (12) A box of 'Pistachio' chocolates is shown. Similar to the previous step, she crushes the chocolates and adds them to a scoop of vanilla ice cream. (13) The final phase shows a collage of the snacks and a pink outro card with social media icons and the website 'japanuts.com'.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator demonstrating the recipes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged woman with dark hair tied back in a bun or ponytail. She wears a simple black long-sleeved shirt in some scenes and a grey knit sweater with an eye-motif in others.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, bright indoor setting featuring white countertops, wooden tables, and a green potted plant in the background. In some shots, a red microwave and various snack packaging are visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo Japanese rock music begins immediately with a driving drum beat and distorted electric guitar. A male singer starts high-energy vocals. (2) Energetic female narration in Mandarin Chinese enters, speaking over the music. (3) A distinct 'thud' sound is heard as the knife cuts through chocolate, followed by the faint rustling of plastic snack bags. (4) A mechanical 'click' sounds when the sandwich press is closed. (5) As the narration describes the four eating methods, the music continues at a consistent high tempo. (6) A 'pop' sound effect highlights the transition to the curry section. (7) A microwave 'ding' and a slight electronic hum are audible. (8) More 'whoosh' sound effects accompany the rapid visual cuts between ingredients. (9) The audio ends with a bright final musical chord and a vocal CTA from the narrator.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Method 1 -> Method 2 -> Method 3 -> Method 4 -> Outro/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Meiji Japanese snacks by demonstrating four creative and appetizing 'hacks' or recipes using their products to enhance the snacking experience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses entirely on Meiji brand products, showcasing their packaging clearly and demonstrating specific ways to consume them, likely as part of a promotional campaign for 'Japanuts'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy editing and bright lighting typical of social media food influencers. The combination of J-pop music and Mandarin narration targets a Chinese-speaking audience interested in Japanese culture and food.
